processes.meter_flow_missing_deal_resolution: Logistics or settlements staff flag meter flow or allocations with no, expired, or mismatched Sitara deal and ask the trader to extend, create, or verify a deal before allocations or invoicing close.
processes.sitara_deal_ticket_cleanup: Logistics asks the deal owner to zero out, revise, or remove Sitara/POPS deal tickets after activity moves to another meter or deal.
processes.eol_deal_change_control: Schedulers and logistics coordinate handling of EOL deal changes, which must not be altered, including rerouting nominations and communicating changes to the desk lead.
processes.unaccounted_gas_writeoff_approval: Logistics and measurement staff request approval or explanation to write off unreconciled or unmetered gas volumes to unaccounted-for gas.
processes.deal_price_discrepancy_resolution: Schedulers or confirmations staff ask the trader to confirm which deal price or index is correct when the counterparty and Enron records disagree.
